translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

book.name: Hechos
book.title: Jesús-nuggin-palmilegalmalad Pab Purpa Nuedbal Immalmal Imasmalad Hechos

content: Pedro Jerusaléngin chogzhagujad, Judiojulmaladgin immal kujad
Tegin Jesús-nuggin-palmilegalmalad-pimalad tegin kwenamalad-Jesucristogin-Judea-napkin-pukmalad wisgusmal, Judiojulmalad Pab-kaka abingasmalmo.
Tegin Pedro untaradgin Jerusalénzhe kannan nonigu, Jesucristogin-kwenamalad-abgan-tuku-chikalmalad Pedroje ulualmal chogalmal:
—¿Ibiga pe tule-abgan-tuku-chikalzhulmaladzhe arpigusdé? ¿Ibiga pe Judiojulmaladbak mes mas kuchamalbaldé? Wedin izhe.
Tegin Pedro nuekwa Judiomal-Jesúsgin-ibzhemaladga palchogalzhun:
“Imi antin Jope-neg-kweburgin maidgin, te ibagwengin an Pabzhe kolal. Tegidgin an imia-akpurrudedgin an immal takcha, atued-tummadyob tuku-tukugin-kugul-tuklukwa edinal anche aktenoni.
Tegin an nuekwa e-yagin takpi-kual, ibimala pukwa. Tegin an taktegu an takal, immalmal-napkined, achu-chapur, immal-yarmakal-nanemalad, tegin chikwimal pukwamal.
“Tegin an itogalbal, tule-kakapurwa anche kolnai: ‘Pedro, pe kwisgu, pe we immalmal-mejo pe kunkal.’
Tegin tule-kakapurwa-anche-kolnonikidga an chogal: ‘Chulá Tummad. Wegiid-immalmal-izhe-kullemalad, an kaka-yabal togo igal-kwen-maichul.’
Tegin tule-kakapurwa nikpa-akar kannan anche kolnonibal: ‘Imi Pab imis-akar pél immalmal-izhe-kulleged nabir-kulle imas. Al anka keg pe chogel: We immalmal izhe kunkal.’
Imi tule-kakapurwa anka ilapá kolnoni. Tegidgin, immal-atued-tummadyob tuklukwa-takleged kannan nikpa aknakwid.
“Imi teun takalgu, tulemal-walapá Cesarea-neg-kwebur-akar an-amidanimalad an-neg-maidzhe nonimal.

Tegin Pab Purpa Nued anka chogzhado: ‘Imi pe akalzhul we tulemalbak pe nao.’ Imi we kwenamalad-walanerkwa-pukmalad anpak mes nadmalmo, Cesareaje. “Tegin anmal Cesareaje omosgu, tule-anche-kochad-negzhe togzhamal.
Tegin Cornelio pel-kwapa anmalga chogzha, ede e-neggin maidgin, Pab-angel eje arpak nononi. Tegin angel ega chogal: ‘Imi pe Jope-neg-kweburzhe tule-kwen-palmio, Simón-Pedroje kolnegal.
Imi we Simón-Pedro pega chogo, pedin tegin pe-neg-yaginmalad igi nabir abonolego melle Pab Tummadzhe peyedzhe oturdalegal.’
“Tegin an ampa tulemalga chunmanaidgin, Pab Purpa Nued anmalga-kepe-saglagin-aktejadyob, we tulemalgin pela-pela aktenonimo.
Tegidgin an wisgud nad, Pab-Jesús anmalga igi chogzha: ‘Imi Juan Bautista chunchunnad tiginbi unnila tule-okcha. Tenal pemal nue-naojul Pab Purpa Nuedgin oglenonimalo.’

“Imi anmal-Judiomal Pab-Jesucristogin-ibzhasmaladbal, Pab Tummad anmalga E-Purpa-Nued-ukcha. Tenal Pab Tummad ampa anmal-yopí tule-Judiojulmaladga E-Purpa-Nued-ukchamo. ¿Imi Pab Tummad Judiojulmaladga E-Purpa-Nued-ukcha-choggu, al antin toa-tule-ade, Pab Tummadga ib choggal? Wedin keg kue.”

Tegin kwenamalad-Jerusaléngin-abgan-tuku-chikalmalad, Pedro-chogzhad itosmalgu, yer itos-pesmal. Tegin Judiomal-Pabgin-ibzhemalad Pab-otummoalmalzhun, chogalmal: —Imi Pab Tummad Judiojulmaladga igal-ukchamo, aga iskuedgin pukib-itononikidbal ilagwen-nadgu tullegal.
Kwenamalad-Antioquíagin-pukmaladgin immalmal-kujad

Imi Judiomal-Esteban-mechamalad-cholbal, tulemal peyedzhe chabzhul Jesúsgin-ibzhemalad-imasmal. Al Jesúsgin-ibzhemalad peyedzhe wilesmal. Al kwenamalad Jerusalén-akar aknidmal. Al we kwenamalad Provincia-Feniciaje, Chipre-tupche, tegin Antioquía-neg-kweburzhe nadmal. Imi teun kwenamalad-aknidmalad Judiomalgabi Pab-Jesús-kaka-nuegangin chunmadi-kusmal.

Tenal tule-wal-walgwen-aknidmalad Antioquía-neg-kweburzhe nonimal. Tenal we kwenamalad Chipre-tol tegin Cirene-tol. Tegin kwenamalad Antioquíaje nonimalgu, Judio-tulemalga tegin Griego-tulemalga Pab-Jesúsgin chunmadi-kusmalmo.
Tenal Pab-kannaleged kwenamaladbak tiidbal tulemal-ichejul Pab-Jesúsgin ibzhenonimal tegin Pab-Jesúsgin naigunonimalbal.
Tegin Jesúsgin-kwenamalad-Jerusaléngin-pukmalad wisgusgu Judiojulmalad Antioquíagin Jesús-abingasmal, Antioquíaje Bernabé-palmialmal.

Tegin Bernabé Antioquíaje nonigu, taknoni, Pab-Jesús wilejakwa-tulemal-takchadbal íchejul tulemal-abonosmal. Al Bernabé peyedzhe yer-itos. Tegin Bernabé Jesúsgin-ibzhemalad-uanaisbal Jesúsgin-ibzhemalad kantik pul-pule Pab-Jesúsgin kwisgumalgal, melle Pab-Jesús-igemalgal.
Tenal Bernabé tule-nued. Tenal Bernabé pela-pela Pab-Purpa-Nued-nika, tegin Pab-kwen-penzhulbal. Tegin tulemal-íchejul Bernabébal Jesúsgin ibzhenonimal.
Tegin Bernabé kep Tarso-neg-kweburzhe Saulo-aminadzhun.

Tegin Bernabé Saulo-amiapku, Antioquíaje Saulo-cheinoni. Tegin Bernabé tegin Saulo Jesucristogin-kwenamaladbak pirkagwen megwiszhun. Tegin Bernabé Saulobak íchejul Pab-Jesús-igalgin tulemal-oturdadi-kusbal. Imi teun Antioquía-neg-kweburgin tule-Jesúsgin-ibzhemalad kep nugzhalenonimal, Cristozhikmalad.
Tegin Bernabé Saulobak Antioquíagin maiun, Pab-kaka-palchogmalad-Jesúsgin-ibzhemalad, Jerusalén-akar Antioquíaje nonimal.

Tegin Pab-kaka-palchoged-walgwen-Agabo-nugad, Jesúsgin-ibzhemalad-abalgin kwisgual. Tegin Agabo Pab Purpa Nuedbal chogal: —Imi iti-nap-naid-ugakche ukul-mejed-ibe-tanikid omodani. (Imi we ukul-mejed-ibe-nonikid Claudio Romano-e-tummadga maiun noni.)
Al tule-Jesúsgin-ibzhemalad-Antioquíagin-pukmalad aga chogzhamal: “Imi anmal immalmal-nikamaladbal Jesúsgin-kwenamalad-Judeagin-pukmaladzhe mani palmienabmal kwenamalad-wis-pentamalgal.”
Tegin kwenamalad pél mani wesmalgu, Bernabé tegin Saulobak mes mani palmismal, Jesúsgin-ibzhemalad-Judeagin-pukmaladga.
